snippet.description:
Functional dependence and independence using Jacobians complete concept, proofs, and solved examples for B.Sc. Maths & Engineering Mathematics.

Iss lecture mein hum discuss karenge Functional Dependence aur Independence ka pura concept using Jacobians. Agar aapka Jacobian determinant zero ke barabar ho jaye ($J = 0$), toh functions ke beech kya relation banta hai aur kaise prove karte hain ki functions functionally dependent hain ya independent, sab kuch detail mein step-by-step explain kiya gaya hai.

Yeh video B.Sc. Mathematics, B.Tech / Engineering Mathematics, GATE, aur IIT JAM ke students ke liye behad important hai.

📌 Topics Covered in this Video:

What is Functional Dependence and Independence?
Condition for Functional Dependence using Jacobian ($J = 0$)
Relationship between dependent functions
Solved examples & university exam practice problems

Timestamps
00:00 - Introduction & Recap of Jacobians
01:40 - Condition when Jacobian = 0 ($J = 0$)
02:50 - Concept of Functional Dependence of Functions
04:10 - Necessary & Sufficient Condition for Dependence
05:50 - Example 1: Testing Dependence of $u, v, w$
07:55 - Example 1: Jacobian Determinant Evaluation ($3 \times 3$)
14:30 - Example 1: Finding Relationship Between Functions ($w = u^3 - 3uv$)
18:00 - Example 2: Testing Dependence of Linear & Quadratic Functions
19:50 - Example 2: Jacobian Determinant Evaluation
24:35 - Example 2: Finding Relationship Between Functions ($u^2 - v^2 = 4w$)
27:30 - Example 3: Proof of Independence by Contradiction
29:30 - Example 3: Determinant Computation & Equating Coefficients
36:50 - Example 4: Testing Dependence of Given Functions
38:20 - Example 4: Jacobian Determinant Evaluation
41:05 - Example 4: Finding Relationship ($u^2 + v^2 = 2w$)
43:20 - Summary & Upcoming Topics (Curve Tracing & Singular Points)

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics

🔗 Previous Lecture:
acobian of Implicit Functions: Concept, Chain Rule  → https://youtu.be/X8T3DoLiJ70

📺 Complete Playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQ2PtdP6tVW8

🔗  Introduction to Determinants →  https://youtu.be/s3QIawgFw9o

🔗  Matrices और Determinants का Geometric Meaning → https://youtu.be/k2qTdIkpg1w

Video pasand aaye toh Like karein aur Fractal Frontier Maths channel ko Subscribe karna na bhoolein. Koi bhi doubt ho toh comments mein zarur batayein!

📚 RECOMMENDED BOOKS / STUDY MATERIAL
If you want to study this topic in more depth, the following books are very helpful:

📘 Thomas' Calculus (15th Edition) – George B. Thomas, Maurice D. Weir & Joel R. Hass
👉 https://amzn.to/48DQjQW

📘 Single Variable Calculus (Hardcover) – James Stewart
👉 https://amzn.to/4cQeZbk

📘 Differential Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

📘 Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering — K.F. Riley
👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus
👉 https://amzn.to/4u0oxqd
